2026_04_MIA_MIN.headline: Miami adjusts without Achane as Minnesota brings Jefferson uncertainty home
2026_04_MIA_MIN.paragraph1: Miami heads to Minnesota after losing De’Von Achane to a season-ending knee injury, putting more pressure on the Dolphins’ passing game and protection plan. The Vikings return home with Kyler Murray directing an offense built around Justin Jefferson, whose ankle injury now bears watching before Sunday. Miami must manufacture efficient early-down offense without its lead back, while Minnesota can stress the Dolphins by pairing its defensive pressure with Jefferson’s ability to create explosive gains if he is available.
2026_04_MIA_MIN.model_rationale: Miami must replace a central offensive playmaker, while Minnesota’s pressure profile and receiving talent create multiple ways to dictate how the matchup is played.
